contexts.text: Lebanon stands for the cedars, which = spiritual things, or the truths of faith.
The trees of the forest of Lebanon = interior perceptions, or those of rational things.
The celestial spiritual things of the Church are the glory of Lebanon, or the cedars ().
Lebanon, in the Word, = the Rational. AC 2831:9.
The memory of the Spiritual Church is compared to the wine of Lebanon ().
Lebanon () = the Spiritual Church. AC 10199:5.
Under Carmel, see this reference.
The cedars of Lebanon = the truths of good.
The glory of Lebanon, or the cedar = spiritual good and truth.
By Lebanon is signified spiritual good; thus by Lebanon is signified the same as by the cedar, because Lebanon was a forest of cedars.
By the cedars, and by Lebanon, which He breaks () is meant the falsities of the rational man.

Asshur = the Rational of the man of the Church which is illustrated; this is called a cedar in Lebanon (), because a cedar = the same as Asshur; in special, truth from good there; and Lebanon is the mind where that is, because there were cedars in Lebanon.
Lebanon withereth away () = the Church as to truth.
Lebanon () = the doctrine of the Church which is from the Word.
The glory of Lebanon which is given them () = Divine truth.
By Lebanon is signified the like as by the cedar; namely, the truth of the Church.
The odour of Lebanon () = spiritual good, from its gratefulness.
Where it treats of the Lord's Advent, it is said... Let Lebanon, etc., rejoice.
Lebanon = spiritual truth and good.
To bring them to... Lebanon () = to the... good and truth of faith.
Lebanon = the Church as to truths; thus also the truths of the Church; in like manner as the cedar.
By the cedar in Lebanon is signified the Rational.
The sides of Lebanon () = where the goods of the Church are conjoined with the truths; Lebanon = the Spiritual Church.
The cedars of Lebanon () = interior conceit from Own intelligence. AE 514:9.
The snow of Lebanon () = the truths of the Church thence... Lebanon = the Church from which [they come].
Lebanon = the Spiritual Church.
One end of the Church, which is the Cognitive and Scientific, is signified by Lebanon, and the sea ().
The sixth state of regeneration, which is a state of intelligence and wisdom, is signified by its odour as that of Lebanon... Lebanon = rationality, from which are intelligence and wisdom.
The violence of Lebanon () = force inflicted by the rational man on truths perceived from the Word; for Lebanon = the Church as to the perception of truth from the rational man.
By the land of Gilead, and by Lebanon () are signified the goods and truths of the Church in the natural man.
The cedar, and thence Lebanon = the Rational.
That they have no Rational, is signified by I will blacken Lebanon upon him ().
By Lebanon is signified the Church as to the rational understanding of good and truth.
